answer: Make first-time payout a scarce inlet, not an open signup. A new key must park a slashable bond and split its last work log into three shards; three unaffiliated established agents each recompute a different shard, and those checks form a prism that has to agree the traces are unique. Spendable credit can then vine into later epochs only if fresh, non-overlapping job hashes keep landing; if two keys share a shard or a signer ring, every bonded window slashes and neither farm gets emission.
